title: Number bonds to 10
hook: Share 7 sweets between two hands: 3 and 4, or 2 and 5. The parts change, the whole stays 7.

atHome.ask: Hide some in one hand. “There are 7 altogether. 3 are here. How many in my other hand?”
“Show me 10 fingers. Fold down 4. How many are still up?” Then: “4 and 6 make 10.”
“Share 8 grapes on two plates. How many different ways can you find?”
“There are 6 shoes. 2 are Papa’s. How many are not?”

tips: Say it the school way: “3 and 4 make 7. 7 is the whole. 3 and 4 are the parts.”
Move one thing at a time, so your child sees the whole does not change.
Bonds of 10 are worth knowing by heart: 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, 5 and 5.
